Line 03Room by room

(D) = deep clean only

Line 03 · What gets done

What's on the list

Room by room, line by line. Deep-only items marked (D).

Kitchen

  1. Counters cleared and wiped
  2. Sink and faucet scrubbed
  3. Stovetop degreased
  4. Microwave, outside
  5. Cabinet fronts wiped
  6. Floor swept and mopped
  7. (D) Inside the microwave
  8. (D) Cabinet tops dusted

Bathrooms

  1. Toilet, inside and out
  2. Tub and shower scrubbed
  3. Vanity and sink wiped
  4. Mirror cleaned
  5. Floor swept and mopped
  6. (D) Grout scrubbed
  7. (D) Shower door descaled

Bedrooms + living

  1. Beds made
  2. Surfaces and shelves dusted
  3. Mirrors and glass cleaned
  4. Cushions straightened
  5. Trash emptied
  6. Floors vacuumed
  7. (D) Ceiling fan blades
  8. (D) Under the beds

Floors

  1. Hard floors swept and mopped
  2. Carpet vacuumed
  3. Rugs vacuumed both sides
  4. (D) Baseboards wiped throughout
  5. (D) Stair risers and treads

End of list. (D) lines come with a deep clean.

Line 04 · The rhythm

Same crew. Same list. Every Other Friday.

Line 05 · The crew

Same crew, same Friday, same list.

The team that cleans your house the first time is the team that comes back. By the third visit they know it.

  1. Visit 01

    They learn the house

    Which sink spots, which shower glass, where the caddy goes first.

  2. Visit 02

    They learn the dog

    Where the hair piles up, which rug to lift, which door stays shut.

  3. Visit 03

    They start where you want

    Your list, in your order. You stop explaining and start coming home to it.

Line 07 · What we clean

Nine visits, each with its own line.

  • 01

    Every-other-week cleaning

    The same crew every visit, so they learn your house, your pets and your preferences.

    Price it

  • 02

    Weekly cleaning

    For busy houses with kids and dogs: floors, kitchen and baths kept ahead of the week.

    Price it

  • 03

    Monthly cleaning

    A fuller once-a-month visit for tidy households that want the bathrooms and floors reset.

    Price it

  • 04

    Deep clean

    Baseboards, door frames, grout and inside the microwave: the list regular visits do not touch.

    Price it

  • 05

    Move-out cleaning for PCS moves

    Military move-out cleans timed around the packers, with photos for your landlord or housing office.

    Price it

  • 06

    Move-in cleaning

    Cabinets, closets and appliances wiped out before the moving truck arrives.

    Price it

  • 07

    Oven & fridge add-on

    Inside the oven and the fridge cleaned and shelves wiped, added to any visit.

    Price it

  • 08

    Inside windows

    Inside glass, sills and tracks cleaned room by room, add it to any visit.

    Price it

  • 09

    Pet hair visit

    Extra time on stairs, sofas and corners where dog and cat hair piles up.

    Price it
